family_policy: all-attempts-retained; no post-result endpoint substitution; any endpoint change creates a new protocol identity

arms.representation: graph/implicit representation when compiler gate passes

power_policy.method: simulation-based power on independent seed or preparation units; publish code and assumptions before confirmation

resource_normalization.weights: freeze measured reference task medians before generation zero

confirmation.budget: reserve 25% of total normalized resource units before generation zero
confirmation.family_adjustment: simultaneous intervals across all finalists and primary estimands

unavailable_l4_negative_control.if_unavailable: mark L4 estimand not estimable and stop that claim
unavailable_l4_negative_control.new_endpoint_requires: new protocol id, fresh confirmation and explicit disclosure

exclusions: Only predeclared infrastructure failure before outcome access; preserve attempt and reason in ledger. Numerical failures remain outcomes, not exclusions.
limitations: pilot values and resource weights are not yet measured
this protocol does not activate campaign admission
